 NEXZ Set to Bring Their First Asia Tour to Kuala Lumpur in May 2027!
 By Savyna 
 November 18, 2026 
 Share 
 Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Linkedin 
 The seven-member global boy group under JYP Entertainment, NEXZ, is set to bring their first Asia tour, ‘NEXZ 1ST ASIA TOUR’, to Zepp KL on May 29, 2027, giving Malaysian fans the opportunity to experience the group’s dynamic performances live. Produced by JYP Entertainment and promoted by Live Nation Malaysia. 
 Having established themselves as a “next-generation performance powerhouse” with high-quality group choreography built on outstanding dance skills, NEXZ leads the stage with command and energy befitting its reputation. With rhythmic movements, powerful performances and complex formations, the group delivers unwavering precision and perfectly synchronized moves that create a thrilling sense of satisfaction for the audience. 
 Having recently gained experience performing at major Latin American festivals like ‘STRAYCITY’ and ‘Rock in Rio’ and finishing its latest release ‘SAUCIN’’ promotions, the members continue to showcase their more relaxed and mature stage presence. 
 NEXZ successfully kicked off their first Asia tour with two concerts at Olympic Hall in Seoul on October 17 and 18, receiving enthusiastic responses from their dedicated fandom, NEX2Y. Adding to the excitement, the “7 members, 7 colors” solo stages, each infused with the individuality of the members, add to the entertainment and thrill the crowd. 
 Following their successful Seoul concerts, NEXZ will continue their global activities with 12 shows in 8 Asian regions: Hyogo on January 16–17, 2027; Aichi on January 23–24; Tokyo on January 30–31; Hong Kong on February 14; Taipei on February 20; Singapore on April 24; and Kuala Lumpur on May 29. Just as the tour title signifies capturing the world with NEXZ’s music and colors, expectations are gathering for the dazzling activities of the group, which will paint the world in its own unique colors. 
 Tickets for ‘NEXZ 1ST ASIA TOUR IN KUALA LUMPUR’ will be available for NEX2Y 2ND GENERATION Membership Presale on Tuesday, 1 December, 12pm – 3pm. Register on FANS application from Wednesday, 18 November, 11am until Friday, 20 November, 11am to participate the presale. 
 Mastercard cardholders have special access to presale tickets on Tuesday, 1 December from 5pm – 11.59pm. Check out priceless.com/music for details. 
 Live Nation members can secure tickets during the Live Nation Presale on Wednesday, 2 December, 1pm – 11.59pm. Visit www.livenation.my for free membership sign-up and presale access.
 Tickets to the general public will go on sale on Thursday, 3 December from 1pm onwards via www.golive-asia.com .
